name: Nakamura Takayuki
source:
A man who lives in Tokyo. 15 years ago, although he had good will towards his pen pal Aya Fumino, when there was no reply to his 10th letter, he began to hate her. 15 years later, he discovers a mysterious 11th letter, and visits Matsue in Shimane Prefecture in order to find her and learn the truth about what happened to her.

[From [url=http://gematsu.com/2015/11/root-letter-introduces-actress-aya-game-system]Gematsu[/url]]
